camera_angle_convention: degrees; Y-up; azimuth 0 at +Z, 90 at +X; elevation +90 top, -90 bottom
label_placement: each visible eight-connected component; maximum interior clearance; same label keeps same color
coordinate_convention: Y-up; front +Z, back -Z, left +X, right -X; orthographic auto-fit
picking: npz face_ids[y,x] original face ID; -1 background; barycentric[y,x] original corner order
visibility: per-pixel z-buffer; two-sided surfaces; equal-depth ties retain lower original face ID
note: Diagnostic view only; unlit BaseColor and no mip/PBR/engine acceptance.

appearance_change.sampling: deterministic original-face barycentric probes; unchanged non-slaves use exact identity
appearance_change.scope: intentional frozen-target appearance change, not candidate reconstruction or quality acceptance
appearance_change.difference_image_scale: fixed 0..sqrt(3) mapped to linear red then sRGB; no acceptance threshold
appearance_change.comparison_images: identical z-buffer and selection; clean source/target/difference before display overlays
